facts.text: Batuu's surface was covered in jungles, oceans, and the petrified remains of ancient trees, referred to by the local Batuuans as "spires," which towered over the planet's landscapes.

evidence.quote: Batuu's surface was covered in jungles, oceans, and the petrified remains of ancient trees, referred to by the local Batuuans as "spires," which towered over the planet's landscapes.

facts.text: Millennia before the rise of the Galactic Empire and prior to the invention of hyperspace travel, Batuu was a popular stopping point for those traveling to Wild Space and the Unknown Regions.

evidence.quote: Millennia before the rise of the Galactic Empire and prior to the invention of hyperspace travel, Batuu was a popular stopping point for those traveling to Wild Space and the Unknown Regions.

facts.text: The largest settlement on the planet was the ancient trading post Black Spire Outpost.

evidence.quote: The largest settlement on the planet was the ancient trading post Black Spire Outpost.

facts.text: By the time of the war between the Resistance and the First Order, the outpost had devolved into a seedy smuggler's haven run by the intimidating Blutopian Oga Garra.

evidence.quote: By the time of the war between the Resistance and the First Order, the outpost had devolved into a seedy smuggler's haven run by the intimidating Blutopian Oga Garra.

facts.text: The world was also home to farming communities, such as Peka and Surabat, and the town of Galma, known for its mechanics.

evidence.quote: The world was also home to farming communities, such as Peka and Surabat, and the town of Galma, known for its mechanics.

facts.text: The world was the location of Black Spire Outpost, a haven for those looking to avoid attracting too much attention to themselves.

evidence.quote: The world was the location of Black Spire Outpost, a haven for those looking to avoid attracting too much attention to themselves.

facts.text: Batuu was once host to massive trees, though the giants were destroyed during a cataclysm that devastated the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: Batuu was once host to massive trees, though the giants were destroyed during a cataclysm that devastated the planet's surface.

facts.text: The remains of the trees became petrified gray and brown stone that towered over their surroundings and were referred to by local Batuuans as "spires." Those spires became landmarks for settlers.

evidence.quote: The remains of the trees became petrified gray and brown stone that towered over their surroundings and were referred to by local Batuuans as "spires." Those spires became landmarks for settlers.

facts.text: A smaller species of dark green conifers called Batuu trees grew in stony soil or clung to rocky surfaces across the planet.

evidence.quote: A smaller species of dark green conifers called Batuu trees grew in stony soil or clung to rocky surfaces across the planet.

facts.text: Golden Lichen was a native form of lichen that grew on many of the planet's towering spires and buildings.

evidence.quote: Golden Lichen was a native form of lichen that grew on many of the planet's towering spires and buildings.

facts.text: In the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Carver Drow was experimenting on growing different types of plants on Batuu.

evidence.quote: In the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Carver Drow was experimenting on growing different types of plants on Batuu.

facts.text: The plants he grew were from all over the galaxy, including Tenoo trees native to the planet Tenoo.

evidence.quote: The plants he grew were from all over the galaxy, including Tenoo trees native to the planet Tenoo.

facts.text: Batuu was host to a variety of different creatures, including the Batlizard, Batuuan braga bear, dugar dugar, lahiroo, pipa bird, Snarlok, nightsnake, terra tree toad, Batuuan Rat, and Spiran Firefly, and birds known as kroa birds were exclusively found on Batuu.

evidence.quote: Batuu was host to a variety of different creatures, including the Batlizard, Batuuan braga bear, dugar dugar, lahiroo, pipa bird, Snarlok, nightsnake, terra tree toad, Batuuan Rat, and Spiran Firefly, and birds known as kroa birds were exclusively found on Batuu.

facts.text: In 34 ABY, creatures such as demlins, acid-spitters and Kowakian monkey-lizards could be found in regions of the Batuu Wilds such as around the Three Suns Overlook, Dead Root Refuge and Hissiq Springs.

evidence.quote: In 34 ABY, creatures such as demlins, acid-spitters and Kowakian monkey-lizards could be found in regions of the Batuu Wilds such as around the Three Suns Overlook, Dead Root Refuge and Hissiq Springs.

facts.text: Millennia before the first settlers landed on Batuu, the planet was covered in giant trees.

evidence.quote: Millennia before the first settlers landed on Batuu, the planet was covered in giant trees.

facts.text: These trees supposedly held advanced forms of sentience, allowing the trees to consciously communicate and influence their surroundings.

evidence.quote: These trees supposedly held advanced forms of sentience, allowing the trees to consciously communicate and influence their surroundings.

facts.text: Over the years, the trees fostered different forms of life including a race called the fae.

evidence.quote: Over the years, the trees fostered different forms of life including a race called the fae.

facts.text: Using the fae, the trees were able to spread across the land.

evidence.quote: Using the fae, the trees were able to spread across the land.

facts.text: Eventually, the trees decided to create more diverse forms of life, suited to survive in different parts of the planet.

evidence.quote: Eventually, the trees decided to create more diverse forms of life, suited to survive in different parts of the planet.

facts.text: This inevitably created an offshoot colony of fae who laid demands for resources from their original progenitors.

evidence.quote: This inevitably created an offshoot colony of fae who laid demands for resources from their original progenitors.

facts.text: Unable to heed the demands of this colony, war broke out between the two factions.

evidence.quote: Unable to heed the demands of this colony, war broke out between the two factions.

facts.text: At some point, a third faction, the newest colony of the trees, entered the war in an attempt to force peace.

evidence.quote: At some point, a third faction, the newest colony of the trees, entered the war in an attempt to force peace.

facts.text: This led many of the fae to extract the energy of the trees themselves, resulting in a cataclysm.

evidence.quote: This led many of the fae to extract the energy of the trees themselves, resulting in a cataclysm.

facts.text: That cataclysm resulted in the trees being destroyed, and they eventually became petrified.

facts.text: The people native to Batuu were known as Batuuans.

evidence.quote: The people native to Batuu were known as Batuuans.

facts.text: Batuuans greeted each other by saying "bright suns" during the day, and "rising moons" at night.

evidence.quote: Batuuans greeted each other by saying "bright suns" during the day, and "rising moons" at night.

facts.text: The planet's largest population center, Black Spire Outpost, was neighbored by rural settlements.

facts.text: In 34 ABY, the outpost had a spaceport for starship arrivals.

evidence.quote: In 34 ABY, the outpost had a spaceport for starship arrivals.

facts.text: Black Spire Outpost Market housed several local merchants, including Black Spire Outfitters, Creature Stall, Jewels of Bith, Toydarian Toymaker, and The Wooden Wookiee.

facts.text: Disney CEO Robert Iger first announced at the D23 Expo on August 15, 2015 that the company would be building a Star Wars–themed land in Disneyland Park at the Disneyland Resort in Anaheim, California and in Disney's Hollywood Studios at the Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida.

evidence.quote: Disney CEO Robert Iger first announced at the D23 Expo on August 15, 2015 that the company would be building a Star Wars–themed land in Disneyland Park at the Disneyland Resort in Anaheim, California and in Disney's Hollywood Studios at the Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida.

facts.text: It was also announced that the lands' setting would be an outpost on a yet-to-be-seen planet on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, just before Wild Space.

evidence.quote: It was also announced that the lands' setting would be an outpost on a yet-to-be-seen planet on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, just before Wild Space.

facts.text: Batuu's landscape of mountains and rock spires came about as a necessity for the Disneyland installation of Galaxy's Edge, which required the re-routing of the Disneyland Railroad and the Rivers of America in Frontierland.

evidence.quote: Batuu's landscape of mountains and rock spires came about as a necessity for the Disneyland installation of Galaxy's Edge, which required the re-routing of the Disneyland Railroad and the Rivers of America in Frontierland.

facts.text: The reworked northern bend of the river features rocky cliffs, trees and waterfalls that block views of the trading post to visitors riding the various vehicles that travel along the river.

evidence.quote: The reworked northern bend of the river features rocky cliffs, trees and waterfalls that block views of the trading post to visitors riding the various vehicles that travel along the river.

facts.text: In turn, Batuu's mountains and spires become an extended background element for the river, allowing for Galaxy's Edge and Frontierland to better function as neighbors.

evidence.quote: In turn, Batuu's mountains and spires become an extended background element for the river, allowing for Galaxy's Edge and Frontierland to better function as neighbors.

facts.text: Real-world inspirations for this rockwork includes Bandelier National Monument and the Bisti Badlands in New Mexico, Badlands National Park in South Dakota, and Petrified Forest National Park in Arizona.

evidence.quote: Real-world inspirations for this rockwork includes Bandelier National Monument and the Bisti Badlands in New Mexico, Badlands National Park in South Dakota, and Petrified Forest National Park in Arizona.

facts.text: Black Spire Outpost (BSO), commonly known as Black Spire, was an outpost settlement on the planet Batuu. Due to Batuu's location on the edge of the Outer Rim Territories, Black Spire Outpost was one of the last stops before Wild Space and the Unknown Regions.

facts.text: Galma, also known as Galma Vicinity, Galma District, or Galma outskirts, was the name of a settlement on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. The settlement's vicinity was host to illegal podraces and droid fights.
entities: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu

evidence.quote: Galma, also known as Galma Vicinity, Galma District, or Galma outskirts, was the name of a settlement on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. The settlement's vicinity was host to illegal podraces and droid fights.

facts.text: Peka was an energetic river community on the Outer Rim planet Batuu that lived in a small settlement mostly made up of tents, huts, and cabins made from natural resources. The inhabitants mostly worked in fishing and farming, and some commuted into Black Spire Outpost.

evidence.quote: Peka was an energetic river community on the Outer Rim planet Batuu that lived in a small settlement mostly made up of tents, huts, and cabins made from natural resources. The inhabitants mostly worked in fishing and farming, and some commuted into Black Spire Outpost.

facts.text: Skirl was a small village located on the distant planet Batuu. Surrounded by ancient, misty woodland on three sides that marked one of the most fertile and beautiful part of Batuu, Skirl had a quiet community of farmers who grew grain.

facts.text: Surabat was a tiny settlement located in the Surabat River Valley on the planet Batuu. Its residents were hardy and reserved folks, many of whom were involved in the dangerous task of harvesting the Golden Lichen that grew on the spires that surrounded the vicinity.
